title: Tavi Costa: Bitcoin “Very Undervalued with “Violent Moves Ahead”
summary: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine Tavi Costa: Bitcoin “Very Undervalued with “Violent Moves Ahead” Tavi Costa, Founder & CEO of Azuria Capital, explains why he thinks Bitcoin looks "very undervalued" right now, with many former supporters giving up on it, and why he expects Bitcoin and silver to see "violent moves" as the Fed's hiking cycle comes to an end. This post Tavi Costa: Bitcoin “Very Undervalued with “Violent Moves Ahead” first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Patrick Green .
